Genotype-frequency prior implied by a breeding design

Source: R/breeding_design.R
breeding_prior.Rd

The public design-prior contract: the c(REF, HET, ALT) vector of single-locus genotype frequencies the breeding scheme implies, consumed directly by call_gt() as its prior and by the engine as its state frequencies. A thin wrapper over single_locus_expectation() – callers should depend on this stable name rather than on the genetics primitive behind it.

Usage

breeding_prior(design, f1 = c(0, 1, 0))

Arguments

design

Design key of the form "BC<n>S<m>" (e.g. "BC2S2", "BC2S3").

f1

Starting F1 genotype-frequency vector, passed through to single_locus_expectation(); defaults to inbred parents c(0, 1, 0).

Value

Named numeric length-3 vector c(REF, HET, ALT) summing to 1.

See also

single_locus_expectation(), call_gt()

Examples

breeding_prior("BC2S3")                          # c(REF = .8594, HET = .0312, ALT = .1094)
#>      REF      HET      ALT 
#> 0.859375 0.031250 0.109375 
call_gt(0, 1, prior = breeding_prior("BC2S3"))   # design prior resists the het flip -> 2
#> [1] 2
